_source: International Commission on Stratigraphy, GSSP table, https://stratigraphy.org/gssps/ (fetched 2026-11-05). Ratified GSSPs with coordinates, Ediacaran to Holocene.
_fixes: Aeronian: ICS lists longitude -14.2119; Hlásná Třebaň (Czech Republic) is at +14.2119.
Dapingian: ICS lists 110.374 E (typo); Huanghuachang, 22 km NE of Yichang, is at 111.374 E.
Valanginian (ratified Dec 2024) and Wuliuan (ratified 2018) are missing from the ICS web table and were added from their ratification papers.
Ediacaran: ICS row says "Ratified 1990" (shared with the Precambrian GSSAs); the Ediacaran GSSP was ratified in 2004.
Wuchiapingian: ICS spells the province "Guanxi"; corrected to Guangxi.
